verdict.rationale: Vanta's docs say it runs automated tests across integrations such as AWS, Okta and GitHub and continuously monitors connected systems. Failing tests can be listed through the Tests API and the MCP server, and custom tests turn pushed data into pass/fail results. Real-time webhooks deliver event notifications instead of polling. missing for 10: documented test-run cadence or latency showing failures surface within hours, independent or hands-on corroboration of continuous testing behavior.
